directions: Suppose your class has just finished celebrating the Teacher’s Day. You are now to write a report to the university newspaper on the celebration activities organized by your class. You will have 30 minutes to write the report. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
To showcase the vibrant Teacher's Day celebration in our class, this report details the activities we organized.

To begin with, we held a heartfelt class meeting. Students took turns to share their precious memories with teachers, expressing gratitude for the teachers' guidance and support. For instance, one student recalled how a teacher patiently helped him overcome difficulties in math. In addition, we presented handmade gifts to our teachers. These gifts, including cards and handicrafts, were filled with students' sincere wishes. Moreover, we prepared a small performance. A group of students sang a song dedicated to teachers, which brought warm smiles to the teachers' faces.

In conclusion, this Teacher's Day celebration was a great success. It not only strengthened the bond between students and teachers but also allowed us to express our deep appreciation. We hope such activities can be held more often in the future.
